description: Public accounts (creators, channels, pages, companies, communities) with their bio, links, and follower and post counts. Pass handle: a profile link, @handle, username or ID. Price per successful call: Apple Music, Bluesky, Facebook, GitHub, Google, Hacker News, Instagram, Komi, Kwai, Lnk.Bio, Linkme, Linktree, Pillar, Pinterest, Reddit, Rumble, Snapchat, SoundCloud, Spotify, Telegram, Threads, TikTok, Truth Social, Twitch, X, YouTube: 1 credit. LinkedIn: 1 credit (public page or web search) or 5 credits (data partner).

country.description: Only on Apple Music or Google. Region: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code such as US or BR (case-insensitive).

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without avatar_url, banner_url, country_code and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

handle.description: A profile link, @handle, username or ID.

lang.description: Only on Apple Music. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

platform.description: Optional with a profile link, which names it; needed with a bare username or ID.

name: get_profile
title: Profile by handle
